title: Morning Brief Special — Australia, Queensland & Gold Coast
description: A special bonus edition focused only on Australia, Queensland and the Gold Coast: a looming lift on the plug-in solar ban, South Australia's aged-care bed-block costs, Queensland's weekend bushfire outbreak and a $1 million cold-case reward, and a Coomera townhouse fire on the Gold Coast. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (호주, 퀵즐랜드, 그리고 골드코스트 소식만 담은 특별편입니다. 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).
